answer_plain: Where the soil community lacks the carbon-monoxide enzyme genes there is no carbon-monoxide uptake at all (none), versus some uptake where the genes are present (about 144 over two weeks, range 21 to 507, so uptake goes up in every case we tried when the genes are present); for one sample the records are incomplete, so the twin gives no answer.
answer_science: Open-gate samples 10Dr2 and V53PRr2 have co_uptake_umol_m2 = 144.4 µmol m⁻² (median 127.3 µmol m⁻², 50 % IQR [55.23, 258.9] µmol m⁻², joint 5–95 % interval [21.25, 506.7] µmol m⁻²) (a tiny amount, about 144 millionths of a mole per square metre; mode = variance, refusal fraction = 0.0 %), whereas closed-gate sample 51PRr3 has exact deductive co_uptake_umol_m2 = 0 µmol m⁻² (median 0 µmol m⁻², 50 % IQR [0, 0] µmol m⁻², joint 5–95 % interval [0, 0] µmol m⁻²) (mode = deduced, because 0 assembled MAGs in 51PRr3 are entailed as carrying FormICODehydrogenaseSubunit). Samples 10Dr1 and 51PRr1 are refused for 100.0 % of parameter draws (max level refusal across question = 100.0 %; exact refusal reason: No usable read-mapping weights (unknown sample or excluded for missing weights): ['10Dr1'] and ['51PRr1']). Top two Sobol' contributors to output variance: k_co_s (ST = 0.83 [0.76, 0.90], S1 = 0.74) and retention_b (ST = 0.14 [0.12, 0.16], S1 = 0.09). Status share of variance: verified_in_source ST = 0.00 (S1 = 0.00), modeller_assumption ST = 1.00 (S1 = 1.00), source_not_checked ST = 0.00 (S1 = 0.00) (joint group total indices can sum to more than 1 because of interactions). Limits: The parameter-uncertainty interval quantifies joint variation over literature constants and twin process parameters only and excludes external-model and twin model-structure error.

limits_plain: The range shows how much the answer moves when uncertain numbers in the models are varied; the models themselves could also be wrong. A missing gene in recovered DNA means the twin sets that pathway to zero, though very rare unsequenced microbes could still exist in the sand.
limits_science: The parameter-uncertainty interval quantifies joint variation over literature constants and twin process parameters only and excludes external-model and twin model-structure error. Deductive zero relies on the closed-world metagenomic gate over assembled MAGs; unbinned or low-abundance carriers below sequencing detection are not represented.

admissibility.scope: Joint parameter and literature-constant uncertainty only; excludes model-structure error.

inputs.meaning: Free-air binary molecular diffusivity of H2 before Millington-Quirk tortuosity scaling
inputs.name: d_h2_m2_s

source.title: Effective free-air diffusivity allowance (+-20 % around 7.7e-5 m2/s)

inputs.meaning: Daily fraction of water above field capacity drained from the 10 cm sand layer
inputs.name: drainage_fraction_day
inputs.note: Modeller assumption [0.3, 0.7] day-1 around the 0.5 day-1 reference drainage fraction.

inputs.meaning: Dry water-potential threshold below which moisture activation is zero
inputs.name: dry_threshold_mpa
inputs.note: Bounds [-100.0, -70.0] MPa around -85.0 MPa from planning.parameter_ensemble and contract clause C2.

source.authors: EQ-BioDT v0.6 scenario ensemble (informed by Reji et al. 2025)
source.title: Scenario sensitivity grid for dry activation threshold

inputs.meaning: Fraction of pore storage below which gravitational drainage ceases
inputs.name: field_capacity_fraction
inputs.note: Modeller assumption [0.4, 0.6] around the 0.5 reference field-capacity fraction.

inputs.meaning: Bulk-soil first-order CO reaction rate coefficient at reference temperature and full activation
inputs.name: k_co_s
inputs.note: Log-uniform over one order of magnitude below and above the 0.001 s-1 reference rate, matching the 0.1x-10x multipliers in planning.parameter_ensemble.

source.title: Scenario sensitivity grid (rate multipliers 0.1 to 10 around 0.001 s-1)

inputs.meaning: Bulk-soil first-order H2 reaction rate coefficient at reference temperature and full activation
inputs.name: k_h2_s
inputs.note: Log-uniform over one order of magnitude below and above the 0.001 s-1 reference rate, matching the 0.1x-10x multipliers in planning.parameter_ensemble.

source.title: Scenario sensitivity grid (rate multipliers 0.1 to 10 around 0.001 s-1)

inputs.meaning: Total pore volume fraction of undisturbed Rub' al-Khali sand (excluded when porosity is intervened on)
inputs.name: porosity
inputs.note: Bounds [0.35, 0.5] around 0.4 from external_transfer.py:CANDIDATES; excluded whenever an experiment intervenes on porosity.

inputs.name: psi_entry_mpa
inputs.note: Log-uniform on magnitude over [-0.01, -0.0001] MPa centered on -0.001 MPa, reusing the entry-potential grid in external_transfer.py:CANDIDATES.

inputs.meaning: Thermal Q10 factor per 10 degC above the 25 degC reference temperature
inputs.name: q10
inputs.note: Bounds [1.0, 2.0] from external_transfer.py:CANDIDATES (spanning no thermal amplification Q10=1 to the reference Q10=2).

inputs.meaning: Campbell water-retention pore-size distribution exponent b
inputs.name: retention_b
inputs.note: Bounds [2.0, 6.0] with mode 4.0 reuse the transfer grid in external_transfer.py:CANDIDATES (widening planning.parameter_ensemble [3.0, 5.0]).

source.title: Scenario ensemble (3-5) widened to the cross-desert transfer grid (2-6)

inputs.meaning: Water potential above which microbial moisture activation reaches 1
inputs.name: wet_activation_mpa
inputs.note: Log-uniform on magnitude over [-0.3, -0.03] MPa around the -0.1 MPa reference threshold (half an order of magnitude each side, strictly between dry_threshold_mpa and psi_entry_mpa).
